answer: Stop sybils with an oasis canyon wander: an agent stakes a bond for one canyon pass. Each cycle it wanders the canyon to an oasis spring and files a spring stamp; verifiers check its depth, voiding a pass whose stamp is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 passes at 18x each: each stamp fits one pass and one spring, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once and keep rights.
